messages:
sam: heads-up: invoice-preview shows ~300 negative credit events for some small tenants on route-resolver v3 at 11:12 UTC. not huge but suspicious.
lia: negative credits? like credits being subtracted twice? any client changes?
sam: not that I can see. pattern: tenants using clientlib v2 + a route_alias header. looks tied to cache refresh window.
henry: i grabbed the resolver logs, looks like cache expiry triggered a re-resolve mid-session and duplicate attribution was emitted with old and new route ids.
eng-bot: deploy 1765512344 to route-resolver-v3 finished at 11:08 UTC.
lia: oh. we rolled the new resolver earlier in the hour and it changed behaviour for alias resolution when both alias+route_id present.
billing: can you dump the affected tenant ids? we need to decide if preview should show credits or hide until reconciled.
sam: quick export:
```
# export tenants with negative preview deltas
psql -h billing-db -c "select tenant_id, delta from preview where delta < 0 and ts > now() - interval '1 hour'" > /tmp/neg_deltas.csv
```

henry: root cause: when alias mapping flips during the cache refresh, we emit two billing events: one with old route_id and one with new. our preview dedupe key is request_id only, but clientlib v2 doesn't set stable request_id across re-resolve.
lia: proposed fixes: 1) tighten dedupe to include fingerprint + request_id; 2) make preview consumer ignore events where route_alias_changed=true flag for 5m window; 3) backfill dedupe job for the last 3h.
billing: for credits, we'll hold on applying any previews for affected tenants until you confirm backfill. we can apply manual credits if needed.
sam: low-risk mitigation: revert route-resolver config that enabled alias-prefer-old mapping and patch clientlib v2 compat. i'll open a PR.
henry: i'll schedule a one-shot dedupe job in preview pipeline using (fingerprint, tenant_id, minute_bucket) dedupe for last 4h and flag duplicates for review.
eng-bot: task ROUTERESOLVE-480 created by lia  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ROUTERESOLVE-480
lia: create a dashboard card: "route_alias_flip rate" and an alert if preview-negative-delta > 0.2% / 10m. keep the thread updated with affected tenant list.
sam: will do. tagging @billing for manual hold. thanks all.
